dedupe_keys.name: art italy transport regulator open data catalogue and data portal

description: Italy's transport regulation authority, the Autorità di regolazione dei trasporti (ART), runs a transport data portal with an open data catalogue. The catalogue lists land transport datasets (29), maritime and inland waterway datasets (2) and one air transport dataset: among them kilometres of railway network by infrastructure manager (national, interconnected and isolated networks) and by line type (high-speed and conventional), track access charge revenues by market segment, service facilities connected to the network by European rail freight corridor, motorway concessions and their tolls and expiry dates, delays and cancellations, taxi and hire-car licences by municipality, coach stations and freight tonnes and tonne-kilometres. The portal's reports cover infrastructure and services for rail, road, air and maritime transport, ports and motorway service areas. Coverage is national. Datasets are free, most updated annually (last modified September 2025 for the rail series); the licence and file formats were not stated on the catalogue page read. Caveats: indicators are aggregated by operator or network, and the catalogue is in Italian. The network lengths, access charges and motorway data support capacity planning and network flow studies of the Italian transport system, and are related to the ANAS road graph and the French ART open data.
